solution_summary: Ma'aden built its Microsoft solution to improve employee-productivity and operational workflows. To do this, it needed to focus on empowering its current workforce for higher productivity and efficiency. Key components included Microsoft 365 Copilot delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Microsoft Copilot Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Microsoft Copilot Studio, processed by Azure OpenAI Service, and then delivered through Microsoft 365 Copilot so Ma'aden can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The governed Microsoft stack gave Ma'aden a reusable foundation for generative ai / llm, ai and machine learning while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate. Ma'aden saw enhanced productivity, with Copilot users saving up to 2,200 hours monthly.
